question: What is the main reason we use bed accessories in nursing care?

options.A: To replace the need for daily bed baths
options.B: To reduce the cost of hospital equipment
options.C: To speed up the hospital discharge process
options.D: To modify beds for patient comfort and safety

explanation: You've got this! Bed accessories are simply tools we use to adjust hospital beds so our patients stay safe and comfortable. [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h1)

question: Why is choosing the right bed accessory so important in the ward?

options.A: It eliminates the need for patient repositioning
options.B: It ensures the bed uses less electrical power
options.C: It prevents complications like skin breakdown and injury
options.D: It shortens the working hours of nursing staff

explanation: Spot on! The right support keeps pressure off vulnerable skin and helps protect your patient from nasty sores. [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h1)

question: What does a bed cradle mainly do?

options.A: To prevent the patient from falling down
options.B: To elevate the head of the patient
options.C: To support the soles of the feet flatly
options.D: To keep bed linens off the patient's body

explanation: Think of a bed cradle like a little tent over the patient. It keeps heavy blankets from pressing down on sensitive skin! [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h2)

question: A patient has severe burns on both legs and cannot bear any weight on them. Which accessory should you use?
explanation: Burned skin is super sensitive. A bed cradle is a lifesaver here because it holds the sheets up and away from the injury. [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h2)

question: What is the shape of a traditional air ring used in the ward?
explanation: Yes! Air rings look just like a little inflatable donut with a hole in the middle. [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h3)

question: Why do modern nursing guidelines tell us to be very careful with traditional air rings?

options.A: They increase the risk of the patient falling off bed
options.B: They make changing bed sheets too difficult for nurses
options.C: They are too expensive for most local health clinics
options.D: They can restrict blood flow and worsen tissue pressure

explanation: Good to know! While they look comfy, the edges can actually squeeze the skin and cut off blood flow around the sore spot. [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h3)

question: Which accessory is specially used to prevent foot drop in patients who are stuck in bed?
explanation: You got it! A footboard keeps the feet upright in a natural position so the Achilles tendon doesn't tighten up. [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h4)

question: What is the main reason for placing bed blocks under the legs of a hospital bed?

options.A: To cushion the impact if the patient tries to climb down
options.B: To prevent the hospital bed from sliding across the floor
options.C: To elevate the entire bed for specific clinical procedures
options.D: To raise the height of the mattress for easier linen change

explanation: Bed blocks tilt the whole frame at once—super helpful when you need quick postural drainage or shock positioning! [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h4)

question: What is your immediate next step if you notice a plastic bed accessory is cracked?

options.A: Remove it from service and report the damage
options.B: Place it in the corner of the ward for later use
options.C: Wrap it with adhesive tape and continue using it
options.D: Clean it with spirit and give it to another patient

explanation: Safety first! Never risk using cracked equipment. Take it out of action right away and report it. [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h5)

question: Why must we regularly clean and disinfect bed accessories?

options.A: To ensure the manufacturer warranty remains valid
options.B: To prevent the fabric covers from fading in color
options.C: To make the metal parts shine under ward lights
options.D: To prevent cross-infection between different patients

explanation: Exactly. Since different patients use these items, thorough cleaning is our best defense against spreading germs in the ward. [learn more](GNS112_U4_T4#GNS112_U4_T4_h5)
